scheme_name: Grant of Marriage Allowance to the Widow's Daughter
other_conditions: Applicant must be a widow with Indian citizenship.
Applicant must be a native of Puducherry by birth or have continuous residence of at least 5 years.
Allowance is only for the first marriage of the daughter.
Marriage must be performed in accordance with the law.
Allowance is granted for the marriage of only one daughter.
Bride's age must be above 18 years.
Bridegroom's age must be above 21 years.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹25,000 for marriage expenses.
